subject: Computer Science
instructions:
Case report: Bias in an automated hiring tool.
Your report must:
- Describe how the screening tool works
- Identify the source of the bias
- Name the group that was harmed
- Propose a mitigation
draft:
The company's system read past resumes and learned which words were common among people it had hired, then gave each new applicant a score from one to five stars.
The trouble started with the training data. Ten years of past hires were mostly men, so the model learned to treat that history as the definition of a good candidate.
As a result, women applicants were pushed down the ranking, and resumes that mentioned a women's college scored lower.
We suggest auditing the scores across gender before each release and retraining on a balanced set of examples.
